parameters.query:
SELECT
  last_updated_at,
  last_run_id,
  NOW() AS run_started_at,
  'run-' || EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint AS run_id
FROM customer_sync_state
WHERE id = 1;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: "query FetchCustomers($cursor: String, $pageSize: Int!) { customers(first: $pageSize, after: $cursor, sortKey: UPDATED_AT, reverse: true) { edges { cursor node { id email firstName lastName numberOfOrders amountSpent { amount currencyCode } updatedAt } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }", variables: { cursor: null, pageSize: 2 } }) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO customer_sync_runs (
  run_id,
  started_at,
  finished_at,
  cursor_before,
  cursor_after,
  customers_fetched,
  contacts_upserted,
  skipped_no_email,
  status,
  error_message
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.run_id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.run_started_at }}'::timestamptz,
  NOW(),
  '{{ $json.last_updated_at }}'::timestamptz,
  '{{ $json.highest_updated_at }}'::timestamptz,
  {{ Number($json.total_customers) }},
  {{ Number($json.customers_mapped) }},
  {{ Number($json.skipped_no_email) }},
  'success',
  NULL
)
ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO UPDATE SET
  finished_at = EXCLUDED.finished_at,
  cursor_after = EXCLUDED.cursor_after,
  customers_fetched = EXCLUDED.customers_fetched,
  contacts_upserted = EXCLUDED.contacts_upserted,
  skipped_no_email = EXCLUDED.skipped_no_email,
  status = EXCLUDED.status,
  error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message;

UPDATE customer_sync_state
SET
  last_updated_at = '{{ $('Extract Summary').first().json.highest_updated_at }}'::timestamptz,
  last_run_id = '{{ $('Extract Summary').first().json.run_id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = 1;
